in_marathi.name: Vijaykumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vijaykumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vijaykumar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vijaya' meaning victory and 'kumar' meaning young boy or prince. It is a powerful name that signifies courage, strength, and victory.

in_bengali.name: Vijaykumar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Victorious Warrior
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vijaykumar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Vijaykumar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vijaya' meaning victory and 'kumar' meaning young boy or prince. It is a powerful name that signifies courage, strength, and victory.
